# pe exp optimize ranks local promptfoo-shaped evaluation scores without providers.
pe exp optimize --scores eval-results.json --output ranked.json
cmp ranked.json want-ranked.json

# Tied scores keep input order, so the first tied candidate wins.
pe exp optimize --scores tied-results.json --output tied-ranked.json
grep '"source": "first"' tied-ranked.json
grep '"accepted": true' tied-ranked.json

# Missing metrics.score is invalid instead of silently becoming zero.
! pe exp optimize --scores missing-score.json
stderr 'score missing for "candidate"'

-- eval-results.json --
{
  "results": {
    "prompts": [
      {"id":"p0", "label":"seed", "raw":"base prompt", "metrics":{"score":0.25}},
      {"id":"p1", "label":"clear", "raw":"clear prompt", "metrics":{"score":0.75}}
    ]
  }
}
-- want-ranked.json --
{
  "selected": {
    "round": 1,
    "source": "clear",
    "prompt": "clear prompt",

    "reason": "provided local score",

    },
    "improvement": 0.5,
    "accepted": true
  },
  "initial": {
    "round": 0,
    "source": "seed",
    "prompt": "base prompt",
    "score": 0.25,
    "reason": "provided local score",
    "metrics": {
      "provided": 0.25
    }
  },
  "trajectory": [
    {
      "round": 0,
      "source": "seed",
      "prompt": "base prompt",
      "score": 0.25,
      "reason": "provided local score",
      "metrics": {
        "provided": 0.25
      }
    },
    {
      "round": 1,
      "source": "clear",
      "prompt": "clear prompt",
      "score": 0.75,
      "reason": "provided local score",
      "metrics": {
        "provided": 0.75
      },
      "improvement": 0.5
    },
    {
      "round": 1,
      "source": "clear",
      "prompt": "clear prompt",
      "score": 0.75,
      "reason": "provided local score",
      "metrics": {
        "provided": 0.75
      },
      "improvement": 0.5,
      "accepted": true
    }
  ],

  "iterations": 1
}
-- tied-results.json --
{
  "results": {
    "prompts": [
      {"id":"p0", "label":"seed", "raw":"base", "metrics":{"score":0.1}},
      {"id":"p1", "label":"first", "raw":"first tied", "metrics":{"score":0.9}},
      {"id":"p2", "label":"second", "raw":"second tied", "metrics":{"score":0.9}}
    ]
  }
}
-- missing-score.json --
{
  "results": {
    "prompts": [
      {"id":"p0", "label":"seed", "raw":"base", "metrics":{"score":0.2}},
      {"id":"p1", "label":"candidate", "raw":"better", "metrics":{}}
    ]
  }
}
